mapper.sql: id, dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, sort, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_data (dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, sort, status) VALUES (#{dictType}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, COALESCE(#{sort}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_data SET dict_type = #{dictType}, dict_label = #{dictLabel}, dict_value = #{dictValue}, sort = COALESCE(#{sort}, sort), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType}
